refactor(validation): share rendered Markdown interpretation

## Summary

Five public validators independently interpreted rendered Markdown, leaving visibility, section, and link behavior distributed across trusted scripts. Introduce one pure interpreted-document module, keep each caller's existing policy choices, and split the existing local filesystem link checks into a mechanical operation-only module.

The standards source installs the shared runtime for workflow validators and retains both operation modules with the pinned parser resources. Focused fixtures execute the validators from installed layouts and all three checks from retained-only layouts. Current guidance records the PR/issue `title` distinction and parse5's bare-`head` fragment behavior explicitly.

Relative to accepted `eb98da8`, the source closure has seven changed regular files and one added regular file, all mode `100644`: `standards.yaml`, both metadata validators, all three documentation check scripts, `operations/lib/rendered-markdown.mjs`, and new `operations/lib/local-markdown-links.mjs`. No source path is removed and pinned vendor bytes are untouched, so the path set changes from 114 to 115. The profile changes from 51 to 52 declarations (22 to 23 exact files), while retaining three checks, two fixes, three repository declarations, one contextual file, and 25 skills.

## Validation

- `node --test test/pr-metadata.test.mjs test/issue-contracts.test.mjs test/repository-readme-check.test.mjs test/project-readme-check.test.mjs test/documentation-check.test.mjs` — 174 tests passed (24 PR, 89 issue, 61 operation)
- `npm run check` — passed
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed
- installed public `@lutzseverino/repo-standards@1.2.2` unfiltered `source validate "$PWD" --json` — `valid: true`, no errors, one `complete` profile with 52 declarations
- Full suite deferred locally as required by the implementation contract; latest CI `Test` and `PR metadata` checks passed

## Review

- Automatic Codex review completed on the initial architecture commit with no findings. The later changes merged current `main`, corrected guidance, and restored bounded issue relationship parity; they did not replace the reviewed architecture, so no broad Codex rereview was requested.
- Independent GPT 5.6 Terra high Standards review found one incorrect documented command; `4a4ad2a` corrected it. Targeted follow-up at `5c887b5` found no remaining standards violation and withdrew its earlier optional test-helper duplication smell because the contract requires purpose-specific public seams.
- Independent GPT 5.6 Terra high Spec review found missing durable source-delta enumeration plus image-alt, keyboard-input, and link-order issue-policy drift. `5c887b5` restores those distinctions and adds public event regressions. Targeted follow-up approved exact head `5c887b5cb6a946e9de900b2b655e4280e60a2751` with no remaining or new material findings.

## Related issue

Closes #45

## Limits

Historical source-acceptance and adoption evidence remains bound to accepted commit `eb98da8` and its 114-file closure. Native child #46 owns the final whole-source review, machine-readable closure refresh, public acquisition, and affected adoption evidence after #44 and this change integrate.

trustedCheck.body:
## Summary

Exercises the trusted pull request metadata workflow from the disposable adopter's final default branch.

## Validation

- The pull request targets final adopted `main`.
- The public `PR metadata` workflow must pass from the base revision.

## Related issue

https://github.com/lutzseverino/repo-canon/issues/38

## Limits

This probe is not merged and exists only until the authorized temporary repository is deleted.
